decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme C0.2/C2 R1 iteration 2; instrument E1/E2; claim ceiling 'nominated'). One flight, one Solver visit per row, seven arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-i2-c1 .. r1-i2-c5 (hand-written candidates), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). NOMINATION IS DECIDED ON THE OFFICIAL COLUMN. Each arm's first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded); every contrast is the paired ROW bootstrap of that arm's column against the delivering lock arm (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915; scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py then stage3_paired_read.py), all read within this one flight. NOMINATION RULE: candidate X is NOMINATED iff (a) the official pooled SLU-F1 delta X minus lock has a CI95 lower bound > 0, AND (b) that delta is above the aa twin's official pooled SLU-F1 delta (aa minus lock, same flight), AND (c) the intent guard holds: rows whose official intent correctness differs from lock <= 7 (the floor 0.65 pp of 1,080). HARM iff the official pooled SLU-F1 delta CI95 upper bound < 0. The twin null (aa minus lock) is read first and reported beside the design's provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant until this cell measures its own null). Among several NOMINATED arms the largest official SLU-F1 delta wins (ties: fewer words). THE NODE-LOCAL READ IS DIAGNOSTIC AND GATES NOTHING: the E2 reader (schema v2; scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_solver_column_read.py) reports exact_set_normalised (the entity exact-set per row of the answer after the delivered row's own normaliser), parse_valid, empty_gold_false_fill, nonempty_exact, per-slot-type counts and the raw-vs-normalised flip table, paired per row against lock, to localise where an official delta comes from; a node-local gain without an official gain is not a nomination, and a nomination needs no node-local screen. (Why: in iteration 1 the node-local screen and the official column disagreed: normalised node-local c5 +1.30 [-0.19, +2.78] vs official -0.15 [-1.23, +0.89]; c3 +4.63 [+2.87, +6.39] vs official +0.96 [-0.16, +2.09].) PLATEAU RULE (programme C0.4): two evaluated rounds without a NOMINATED arm lock the delivering template and close the node. A nomination is confirmed once on TRAIN Fold A as a two-arm column before any lock; it admits nothing by itself. The delivering lock arm's own offline post-processing columns v4 and v4g are read beside (analysis recipe, offline_columns). THIS IS THE SECOND AND LAST EVALUATED ROUND of R1 under the plateau rule: if no arm is NOMINATED here the delivering template is locked and the node closes. The iteration-1 arm r1-c5 does NOT fly in this column; each iteration-2 arm is also set beside iteration-1 r1-c5 in a cross-iteration table that is DESCRIPTIVE only (different flights, different offsets: no claim, no nomination, no input to the rule above). Iteration 1's registered rule and verdict stand as written.
